name: Iletisim Makinesi Entegrasyon Platformu
author: Hermes İletişim

sections.description:
A plugin that seamlessly syncs your WooCommerce sales, products, and customers with İletişim Makinesi. Leverage İletişim Makinesi to automate abandoned cart emails, build your newsletter audience, and grow your business effortlessly.
Plugin uses İletişim Makinesi as a third party service. When you enter the acquired token from İletişim Makinesi to imep Options menu, your WooCommerce will be entegrated with İletişim Makinesi and certain events such as whenever someone sign-up to your site or someone added a product to their cart will be sent to İletişim Makinesi. For more information please visit https://iletisimmakinesi.com/. For privacy policy https://iletisimmakinesi.com/gizlilik-politikasi.
sections.installation:
Integrating İletişim Makinesi and your WooCommerce store is simple:

  1. Install/activate İletişim Makinesi’s plugin.
  2. Click on imep Options in your left-menu, then submit yout token and finish yout integration.
